match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: MARA kneads the dough, then glances at the wall clock. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Observational handheld frame with MARA at the steel bench, dough and flour in the foreground and the wall clock visible behind her. Placement only, not the pose: MARA leans over the steel bench in a flour-dusted apron, hands on the dough, focused on kneading. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld drift, subtle, unhurried. Characters: MARA, Female, 30s, A woman in her 30s, of average height, A white cotton baker’s shirt, a flour-dusted natural-canvas. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
